description: Font loading optimizations: add font-display:swap to both Google Fonts requests in index.html (already has display=swap in URL but confirm) and App.scss. Add a <link rel=preload> for the most critical font subset. Add preconnect for gstatic.com in index.html (already present - confirm). Consolidate the extra Cormorant Garamond @import in App.scss into the combined Google Fonts URL in index.html so it shares the same connection and benefits from a single request.
steps: 1. Read index.html at /projects/sandbox/electron/index.html. The existing Google Fonts link already includes `display=swap` in the URL - confirm it is present.

2. Read /projects/sandbox/electron/src/app/App.scss line 6. It has a separate `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap')`. This creates a second render-blocking request. Merge Cormorant Garamond into the combined Google Fonts URL already in index.html by appending `&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700` to the existing href parameter list.
3. Remove the `@import url(...)` line from App.scss line 6 after adding the family to index.html.
4. In index.html, add a `<link rel="preload" as="style">` tag for the same Google Fonts CSS URL, placed BEFORE the existing stylesheet link. This triggers the font CSS download earlier.
5. Verify the index.html has `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />` (it already does - confirm it is there).

6. In netlify.toml, add a `[[headers]]` block for `/*` that sets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for JS/CSS/font assets (e.g., `/*.js`, `/*.css`, `/assets/*`), and a shorter cache for HTML. Example:
```
[[headers]]
  for = "/assets/*"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"

[[headers]]
  for = "/*.html"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "no-cache"

[[headers]]
  for = "/index.html"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "no-cache"
```
acceptance_criteria: App.scss no longer has a standalone @import for Cormorant Garamond
index.html Google Fonts URL includes family=Cormorant+Garamond
index.html has both preconnect and preload hints for Google Fonts
netlify.toml has [[headers]] entries for /assets/* with immutable cache and /index.html with no-cache
vercel.json has headers array entries for /assets/* with immutable cache and /index.html with no-cache
verification: grep -n 'Cormorant' /projects/sandbox/electron/src/app/App.scss - should not appear as @import, but font-family references remain
grep -n 'Cormorant' /projects/sandbox/electron/index.html - should appear in the fonts URL
grep -n 'preload' /projects/sandbox/electron/index.html - should find the preload link
